protocol.scope: Transforms one retrospective anecdote into at most one prospective, locally testable claim record; it does not validate the anecdote or infer causality.
protocol.operator_model: A human or extractor proposes exact title/body spans; deterministic gates validate the packet. Free-form completion of missing facts is forbidden.

the source links precondition and observable without reversing or ambiguously negating failure polarity
every factual output element maps to an exact source span; every other element is INFERRED with a statement
one prospective trial establishes only the extracted precondition and records only the extracted observable
the record carries a Sherman-Kent band and the named independent verification path
